topic: Improve, refine and expand the Jev citation drift scan (cli-jev feature 032). Its scorer is .skilled/skills/sk-doc/shared/scripts/cite-drift-scan.mjs in sk-doc, and it measures sk-doc document validation, which resolves path:line citations in tracked skill docs and reports dead ones with zero calls. Measured result: verdict jev: keep K=40 M=40 A=35 B=13 W=22 L=0 TP=26 FP=0 F=3 p=2.384e-7. Real data on a small sample of 40. Jev judges whether a live citation still supports its claim, which the zero-call check cannot. Answer five questions with file:line evidence: what drove this result, how to raise its accuracy or lower its cost, how to make the measurement more trustworthy, where else in .skilled the same judgment would pay off, and what a default-on integration would need, cost and risk.

focus: What drove the measured result: reconstruct census -> draw -> labels -> Jev arm -> keep rule
noveltyJustification: First iteration of a fresh lineage; the kind-split replay of the published counts from calls.jsonl + labels is new evidence in the feature's trail

focus: Raising accuracy and lowering cost: model-arm cost shape, census read waste, aggregation sweep, payload flaw, adaptive reruns
noveltyJustification: Aggregation sweep, 8667-to-82 doc-reader ratio, adaptive-rerun arithmetic and the bare-evidence payload flaw are new

focus: Making the measurement more trustworthy: per-kind sign split, label reliability from committed drafts, frontier rows, recording gaps, test gaps
noveltyJustification: Per-kind W/L split, kappa from the committed rater drafts, the frontier-row coincidence and the recording-gap inventory are new

focus: Where else the same judgment pays off: adjacent corpora, neighbor checkers, unresolved characterization, ranked surfaces
noveltyJustification: Specs corpus sizing, the mirrors null result, the illustrative-unresolved characterization and the ranked surfaces are new

focus: What a default-on integration needs, cost and risk: reader, cadence, label lifecycle, qualification, record, risk register
noveltyJustification: Integration shape, label-lifecycle conclusion, widened-qualification need and risk register are new synthesis
